intro: A good Instagram caption does one thing: it gives your photo a mood or a reason. Here are 150 original captions, grouped by the kind of post. Tap Copy next to any line and paste it into Instagram.

All of them are written for this page and free to use. Most read fine in lowercase, and they get better if you change a word so it sounds like you. At the end there is a short guide to writing your own.

sections.lead: These work on nearly any photo, because they talk about the moment and not the picture.
captions: a day worth the storage space
exactly where i meant to be
the kind of day you don't plan
not much happened. it was perfect
the part of the week i'd repeat
a good one for the archive
this felt longer than it was, in the best way

sections.lead: Say less. Cool captions sound like you barely thought about them, even when you did.
One to three words. Good for when the photo is the whole point.
Self-aware beats clever. The easiest joke is admitting why you are posting this at all.
captions: posting this before i change my mind
my therapist will hear about this
the group chat approved this one
i peaked and i have photos
my screen time would like a word
my phone storage made me do it
this took three outfits and one small crisis
i look like i have my life together. i do not
brb, becoming a morning person. never mind
i was told there would be snacks

sections.lead: Quiet and lowercase. Name a light, a colour or a feeling and stop there.
captions: a colour i can't name yet
the blue part of the evening

sections.lead: Own it or joke about it. Both work better than pretending someone else took the photo.
captions: the front camera was kind today
this is my good side. they all are
selfie, because no one else offered
outfit was too good to waste
took one and it was the one (it was not)
evidence that i own a mirror
this is what rested looks like, apparently
the lighting did most of the work

sections.lead: Tag them, then let the caption sound like the group chat.
captions: people i'd share my last fry with
we were told to keep it down
the reason i'm always late home
still the same jokes, still funny
no one here is the sensible one
they know too much, so i keep them close
friendship is mostly voice notes and this
you can't sit with us (you can, there's room)

sections.lead: Name the feeling, not the itinerary. The photo already shows where you are.
captions: out of office, in the sea
time zones are a state of mind
my suitcase is heavier and so am i
somewhere with a better view of my problems
i came for the weather and stayed for the bread
homesick for places i just left
one more day, i keep saying

captions: the salad was for the photo
this was gone in four minutes
i ordered for the table. i was the table
a very balanced meal, if you hold it level

sections.lead: For the ordinary week, the desk, the walk, the post with no occasion at all.
captions: an ordinary thursday, for the record
nothing happened and i loved it
the desk, the coffee, the deadline
the small stuff was the good stuff

sections.h2: How to write a good Instagram caption
sections.lead: Look at the photo and ask what it feels like. Then say that in as few words as you can.
sections.html:
• Lead with the line that matters. Instagram cuts longer captions off after the first line or so, with a "more" link, so the opening has to work alone.
  • Add something the photo can't. A beach photo with the caption "beach" says nothing. A beach photo captioned "out of office, in the sea" has a voice.
  • Match the post. A personal photo can take one word. A how-to or a story can run to a paragraph if it earns it.
  • Sound like yourself. Change one word in any line above to something you would say.
  • Choose your case on purpose. Lowercase reads relaxed; sentence case reads more polished.
  • Keep hashtags few and at the end. They should not interrupt the line.

faq.q: What is a good caption for an Instagram post?
faq.a: A short line that adds a mood or a reason rather than describing the photo. "this is the good part" or "evidence of a nice day" work on nearly any post.

faq.q: How long should an Instagram caption be?
faq.a: It can be up to 2,200 characters, but a line or two is enough for most personal posts. Instagram truncates long captions in the feed, so put the important part first.

faq.q: What are cool captions for Instagram?
faq.a: Very short, slightly unbothered lines such as "no notes", "as planned" or "working as intended". The less the caption tries, the cooler it tends to read.

faq.q: Can I use these captions for free?
faq.a: Yes. They are original lines written for this page, free to copy and change. If you like them, use them.

faq.q: Does DUMP write captions for me?
faq.a: DUMP's Caption Generator (Premium) offers hand-written lines in six moods: Soft, Funny, Travel, Monthly Recap, Influencer and Minimal. It is not AI, and it does not look at your photos.
